From a7f2e9272aff1ccfe0fc801dab1d5a7a1c6b7ed2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2021 10:41:00 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] xhci: Fix 5.12 regression of missing xHC cache clearing
 command after a Stall

If endpoints halts due to a stall then the dequeue pointer read from
hardware may already be set ahead of the stalled TRB.
After commit 674f8438c121 ("xhci: split handling halted endpoints into two
steps") in 5.12 xhci driver won't issue a Set TR Dequeue if hardware
dequeue pointer is already in the right place.

Turns out the "Set TR Dequeue pointer" command is anyway needed as it in
addition to moving the dequeue pointer also clears endpoint state and
cache.

Fixes: 674f8438c121 ("xhci: split handling halted endpoints into two steps")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # 5.12
Reported-by: Peter Ganzhorn <peter.ganzhorn@googlemail.com>
Tested-by: Peter Ganzhorn <peter.ganzhorn@googlemail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210525074100.1154090-3-mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
index 256d336354a0..6acd2329e08d 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
@@ -933,14 +933,18 @@ static int xhci_invalidate_cancelled_tds(struct xhci_virt_ep *ep)
 			continue;
 		}
 		/*
-		 * If ring stopped on the TD we need to cancel, then we have to
+		 * If a ring stopped on the TD we need to cancel then we have to
 		 * move the xHC endpoint ring dequeue pointer past this TD.
+		 * Rings halted due to STALL may show hw_deq is past the stalled
+		 * TD, but still require a set TR Deq command to flush xHC cache.
 		 */
 		hw_deq = xhci_get_hw_deq(xhci, ep->vdev, ep->ep_index,
 					 td->urb->stream_id);
 		hw_deq &= ~0xf;
 
-		if (trb_in_td(xhci, td->start_seg, td->first_trb,
+		if (td->cancel_status == TD_HALTED) {
+			cached_td = td;
+		} else if (trb_in_td(xhci, td->start_seg, td->first_trb,
 			      td->last_trb, hw_deq, false)) {
 			switch (td->cancel_status) {
 			case TD_CLEARED: /* TD is already no-op */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c`**
- The comment block was updated to clarify the behavior of the xHCI endpoint ring when it is halted due to a STALL condition. 
- A new condition was added to check if the `cancel_status` of the transfer descriptor (TD) is `TD_HALTED`. If it is, the `cached_td` variable is set to the current `td`.
- The logic for moving the dequeue pointer was modified to ensure that even if the hardware dequeue pointer is past the stalled TD, a "Set TR Dequeue" command is still issued to flush the xHC cache.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `xhci-ring.c` address a regression introduced in version 5.12 of the xHCI driver, specifically related to how halted endpoints are handled after a stall. The patch ensures that the necessary command to clear the endpoint state and cache is issued, even when the hardware dequeue pointer appears to be correctly positioned. This change is a direct response to the issues caused by the previous commit (674f8438c121) that altered the handling of halted endpoints, thereby restoring the intended functionality and fixing the regression.
